title: Gator
creator: CrossFit
description: Eight rounds of 5 front squats at 185/125 lb and 26 ring push-ups. Honours U.S. Army Spc. Christopher "Gator" Gathercole, 75th Ranger Regiment, killed by enemy fire in Ghazni, Afghanistan, in 2008. 208 ring push-ups; scale to the floor when form goes.
